SELECT p.POST_ID , p.TITLE , U.NAME , p.STATUS , p.RECRUIT_CNT , ts.TECH_STACK_CD , rs.RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_NM , (SELECT DTL_CD_NM FROM CMM_CODE_DTL WHERE COM_CD_ID ='PROGRESS_TYPE_CD' AND DTL_CD_ID = P.PROGRESS_TYPE_CD) AS PROGRESS_TYPE_CD , p.VIEW_CNT , p.RECRUIT_END_DATE FROM POST p LEFT JOIN USERS u ON P.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN( SELECT POST_ID , LISTAGG(pts.TECH_STACK_CD, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pts.TECH_STACK_CD DESC) AS TECH_STACK_CD FROM POST_TECH_STACK pts GROUP BY POST_ID )ts ON p.POST_ID = ts.POST_ID LEFT JOIN( SELECT POST_ID , LISTAGG( (SELECT DTL_CD_NM FROM CMM_CODE_DTL WHERE CMM_CODE_DTL.COM_CD_ID = 'RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_CD' AND CMM_CODE_DTL.DTL_CD_ID = prp.RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_CD), ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY prp.RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_CD DESC) AS RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_NM FROM POST_RECRUIT_POSITION prp GROUP BY POST_ID )RS ON p.POST_ID = RS.POST_ID
